quotes.author: Jeff
quotes.text: Boat was ready, fueled, and clean. Good safety briefing. Good location. They were ready for us when we returned to help with lines/docking. I’d rent again from them in the future - my only criticism would be that there weren’t enough pictures of the boats online! Tackle store on site and a dive shop 2 doors down.

quotes.author: Brent R
quotes.text: The pontoon was newer and and well kept. I was happy to see a Garmin with charts to help me navigate. I’ve boated on lakes in the Midwest all my life, but was intimidated by the open water. The employee helped me find and set waypoints to areas we wanted to visit. It was the best part of our vacation.

quotes.author: flleduc
quotes.text: This is the BEST place around Islamorada to rent a boat. They are in pristine condition, pricing best around and customer service the best. This is our third time renting and hope to be back again soon. Thank you....

quotes.author: William R
quotes.text: Saw dolphin pod on our way back. Little rough water on ocean side but no fault of watersports company. Manatees in channel when we returned boat to complete a great day.

quotes.author: Jennifer P
quotes.text: The boat was clean and reliable, the staff friendly both times we used them to rent boats. We would definitely use again!
